item.title: Goat Life 0.3.0
item.description:
Your goat can finally have a name. It's been waiting to ask.

  • What's my name? On first launch your goat asks for one, with a few ideas if you're stuck. Rename it any time and it tries the new one on.
  • A proper face. A new app icon, and the menu bar now shows your goat's face: happy, content, meh, sad, or fast asleep.
  • A nicer panel. Click the menu bar goat for a little panel showing what it's up to, with big Food, Drink and Bed buttons. Settings live in there too.
  • It talks. Speech bubbles with actual words, and buttons when it wants something, so you can answer "Anything to eat?" right there.
  • Pet it while it sleeps. Rest your pointer on a sleeping goat and stroke it. It stays asleep, and a little heart floats up.
